solutionSql:
SELECT id, name
FROM customers
WHERE UPPER(LEFT(name, 1)) BETWEEN 'B' AND 'D'
ORDER BY name ASC;

ambiguities.phrase: Return id and name for customers whose name starts with a letter from B to D, inclusive.
ambiguities.readingChosen: The first letter is compared case-insensitively, so lowercase b, c and d also match.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: A case-sensitive ASCII range, so only capitalised initials match.

notes: No sample name starts with a lowercase letter, so the case choice does not change the sample result. Dovetail Lanterns, the boundary the ticket names, is included.
